propositions: Current CLI facade has overlapping frozensets, regex-based reference generation, and 54 hand-maintained help resources causing parser/help drift and inconsistent command documentation.
Twenty-one intercept-only commands lack safe canonical help; rebar help reports them unknown while handler-owned --help is inconsistent and can execute work.
Every command grammar must be built by a single side-effect-free stdlib argparse factory used identically at runtime execution and build-time generation to eliminate parser authority drift.
Runtime overview/help must read committed pre-generated package-help and overview bytes before operation snapshot, config materialization, mount, or handler resolution to keep help pre-operation.

Aliases must reuse canonical grammar/help; bridge-fsck, bridge-probe, jira-onboard, bridge-status, and purge-bridge follow explicit compatibility contracts including historical spellings and visibility rules.
Semantic capability registry maps capabilities to missing postures (error, unavailable, abstain, fallback) without eager optional imports, with checks deferred until selected mode/backend is known.
